development_scope: Two separately registered development cohorts. Later development could see earlier results; these are not fresh final results or an unbiased method ranking.
prior: Finite homogeneous linear predictive state; unsupervised coordinates/features or greedy neural pruning; fixed analytical recognition of a particular latent Markov family after operator learning. Not unrestricted program discovery, a supplied HMM optimization adapter, a minimality certificate or semantic causal recovery.
additional_query_comparison: Geometry, PCA and SAE use only cached observations. Transcoder and causal variants execute weights and count their extra vectors/ablations. Paired histories/probabilities do not imply equal query/compute budgets.
orchestration_failure: Geometry scoring initially stopped before predictions because its source import capsule lacked project metadata needed for provenance. Added exact source/metadata mirrors, preserved the failed directory and resumed scoring in fresh namespaces from all ten original registered executables. No extraction was repeated.

family_evidence.interpretation: Numerical realization compatibility, not an exact equivalence, minimality or causal certificate. The analytical recognition class is built into this method.

resources.neural_count_scope: All helper executions including ablations, every returned probability vector counted. Cached observation collection is additional and unchanged.
resources.assumptions: Learned feature map or greedy circuit pruning followed by autonomous linear-state identification; no supplied HMM adapter. Representation evidence does not establish recovered latent semantics or a causal mechanism.

representation.ablation: Greedy layer/head order, cumulative zero ablations before attention output projection; retain removal only at mean KL <= 0.005 against the original cached probabilities.
representation.causal_scope: Ablation effects on neural predictions only. No semantic intervention alignment to a recovered generating process, circuit completeness, or causal recovery is established.
